ValidationRule.description: Prevents MillTrack technicians from directly changing the Work Order or Part Catalog on an existing Work Order Part.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.MillTrack_Technician_Restricted_Editing, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED( Part_Catalog__c ), ISCHANGED( Work_Order__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Technicians cannot change the Work Order or Part Catalog on an existing Work Order Part. Use the approved service workflow instead.
